The BioWare Community Live Team presents:
 
'Neverwinter Nights: Kingmaker' v1.1
 
Designed by:
  Dan Whiteside
  Cori May
 
Starting Level: 1
Number of Players: 1
 
In a party with a cowardly wererat, a scarred nymph, an exiled rakshasa, and a quick-tempered azer, you seem to be the only normal one... but are you? Evil lurks in a war-torn keep. To learn the truth, you must win the throne.
